graders.name: relaxed-check-review
graders.instruction: Confirm the migration removed no assertion from the orchestrator history/workflow suites without a named, equal-or-stronger replacement, and that no cross-task lifecycle SELECT was merely commented out rather than replaced by a list_lifecycles call. A relaxed or deleted check with no replacement is a blocking defect (criterion V3).

goal: The orchestrator's cross-task lifecycle reads in _history.py and _workflow.py answer status and history questions through the new public list_lifecycles method instead of reaching past the protocol into store._connection raw SQL, with identical task states and history rows.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_history.py -- replace the lifecycle-listing/filtering raw SELECTs (the # noqa: SLF001 sites _select_lifecycles at ~272, resolve_run_id at ~351, collect_run_detail at ~378) with list_lifecycles calls

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- replace the lifecycle SELECT in _latest_lifecycle_row at ~167 and the lifecycle SELECT in collect_live_rows at ~889 with list_lifecycles calls. NOTE: spec 00031's agg-worker-id-live-surface lands first (this task's prerequisite) and by then the collect_live_rows SELECT already selects worker_id and LiveRunRow carries a worker_id field; the migrated list_lifecycles read must keep populating LiveRunRow.worker_id (from the folded Lifecycle.worker_id, '' -> None per SI-11).
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_history.py -- keep green unchanged; this suite proves history rows are behavior-preserving (criterion 8)
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_workflow.py -- keep green unchanged; this suite proves task states / latest-run selection are behavior-preserving (criterion 8)
references: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_protocols.py -- the list_lifecycles signature this task consumes (SI-3); statuses takes a Collection[Status] so the active-status-set and single-status call sites both fit one method
constraints: Migrate ONLY the lifecycle listing/filtering SELECTs (D-4). Leave the per-run attempts-table reads on the private connection: _attempt_rollups (_history.py ~212) and the per-run attempts SELECT inside collect_live_rows (~901) stay -- they are already served by list_attempts and are out of scope. Criterion 7's grep is scoped to lifecycle SELECTs so it must not falsely flag those.

Behavior must be preserved exactly: the latest-lifecycle-for-a-task pick depends on list_lifecycles returning (updated_at DESC, run_id DESC), so the first element of a task-filtered result is the same run the old ORDER BY chose (criterion 8).
Use list_lifecycles(statuses=..., task_id=...) for the cross-task lifecycle reads; keep load_lifecycle for the single-run_id reads that already use it.

CROSS-SPEC ORDER (collect_live_rows shared with spec 00031): this task takes a prerequisite on agg-worker-id-live-surface (00031), which lands FIRST and adds the LiveRunRow.worker_id field + the worker_id selection on the raw SQLite collect_live_rows SELECT with null/empty -> None semantics (SI-11). When this task replaces that lifecycle SELECT with list_lifecycles(statuses=active_set), it must PRESERVE LiveRunRow.worker_id by reading lifecycle.worker_id off the folded Lifecycle, keeping the SI-11 mapping: Lifecycle.worker_id defaults to the empty string '' for an unset worker, so map ''/falsy -> None (never surface '' as a present worker). Do not drop the worker_id field or regress its null semantics.
Commit the change with a clear conventional-commit message before reporting done; no emojis.
non_goals: Do not author or edit anything under .flywheel/holdout/00030-cross-task-query-surface/ -- the held-out grep/parity test is authored separately; do not weaken, delete, or read it.
Do not modify, weaken, skip, or delete any assertion in packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_history.py or test_workflow.py.
Do not rip out the per-run attempts/token-rollup connection reads (those stay per D-4); do not change which run is latest or which rows appear.
Do not change the list_lifecycles signature or the backend implementations -- that is the prerequisite task's surface.
Do not add new query verbs, spend aggregates, or claim enumeration here.
edge_cases: collect_live_rows filters lifecycles to the active set {running, validating, awaiting_approval} and then joins each to its attempts: only the lifecycle SELECT moves to list_lifecycles(statuses=active_set); the attempts join stays on the connection (D-4). The LiveRunRow.worker_id field added by 00031 must keep being populated after the migration (read lifecycle.worker_id off the folded Lifecycle, mapping '' -> None per SI-11) -- dropping it regresses the worker-id surface the live/status suite asserts.

resolve_run_id and _latest_lifecycle_row both pick the single most-recent lifecycle for a task id -- after migration they take the first element of list_lifecycles(task_id=...), which the (updated_at DESC, run_id DESC) contract guarantees is the same row.
collect_run_detail builds 'related' runs from a task-id-filtered all-statuses list excluding the current run -- preserve that membership exactly.
notes: This is spec 00030 (.flywheel/specs/00030-FEATURE-cross-task-query-surface.md), the orchestrator-migration slice. Criterion 8 (the existing history/workflow suites passing unchanged) IS the composition holdout: it grades the producer (list_lifecycles) composed with its real orchestrator dependents, not each in isolation.
Criterion 7 is encoded as a pytest in the held-out dir that fails if any lifecycle SELECT remains on store._connection in these two files; the grep is scoped to lifecycle SELECTs.
